name: GripturaX
summary:
GripturaX is a high-energy VR multiplayer game inspired by the viral hit Gorilla Tag, where movement is everything and the only limit is your skill. Using nothing but your hands, you’ll run, climb, swing, and launch yourself through immersive environments in a fast-paced game of tag that’s as fun as it is physically intense.
